h2: Which Site Office Container Fits Your Project Programme?
intro:
Start with how many people sign in every morning, not with the length of the box. Width sets the desk count here. A 20 x 8 ft cabin seats three along one wall and keeps a clear central aisle. Move to 10 or 12 ft of width and a second desk run opens up, which is why the 40 x 12 ft layout reaches twelve workstations. Length then decides whether you get one open room or a manager cabin behind a partition.

Compare that against the rest of [the container office range](https://www.samanportable.com/product/container-offices) before you commit. This page suits a live construction plot, where the office moves as the work front moves. Mud, dust and visitors all arrive at the same door. If the programme is fixed and the office stays put for years, a different build usually costs less. Send us the plot layout and the headcount, and we will mark the size on a GA plan. [Send your site details for a quotation](https://www.samanportable.com/contact).

panels.h3: 20 x 8 ft Site Office Container for a Three-Desk Team
panels.paragraph: At 160 sq ft this is the smallest office SAMAN will sign a GA plan for. Three workstations sit along the rear wall, each with a chair and an overhead file cabinet. The aisle down the middle stays clear, so nobody squeezes past a drawing table. One door on the front wall keeps entry controlled at a single point. Six windows give cross light. At 8 ft of width there is no room for a second desk run. Treat three seats as the honest limit.
applications: Rs 2,37,600 ex GST, Rs 2,80,368 with 18 per cent GST
1 door, 6 windows, 3 workstations, 3 seats, no partition
Fits a narrow gate-side plot or a footpath-width setback
Smallest unit that still takes a full plan table

panels.h3: 20 x 10 ft Site Office Container Seating Five People
panels.paragraph: Two extra feet of width change the plan completely. Five workstations now fit, three along the rear wall and two along the front, and the aisle still runs clear between them. This is the size most Indian site teams settle on for a mid-size project. It holds a site engineer, a supervisor, a billing assistant and two more desks without feeling cramped. The door and window positions match the 20 x 8 ft plan, so the entry discipline stays the same.
applications: Rs 2,70,000 ex GST, Rs 3,18,600 with 18 per cent GST

panels.h3: 30 x 10 ft Site Office Container With Two Site Doors
panels.paragraph: Thirty feet of length brings a second door, and that changes how the room works. Site staff enter at one end in boots, while visitors and clients use the other. Eight workstations line up, five along the rear wall and three along the front, with eight windows spreading daylight down the whole run. We keep this at eight desks rather than pushing to twelve, because a project office needs floor space for plan tables and standing conversations.
applications: Rs 3,88,800 ex GST, Rs 4,58,784 with 18 per cent GST
2 doors, 8 windows, 8 workstations, 8 seats, no partition

panels.h3: 40 x 8 ft Site Office Container With a Manager Cabin
panels.paragraph: This is the first layout with a partition. The first 10 ft becomes a private manager cabin with its own desk and two guest chairs, reached through an internal door. Behind it, a 30 ft common office runs seven workstations along one wall. Ten seats in total. At 8 ft of width the common room stays single-sided. Pick it when a closed meeting room matters more to you than want extra desks. An internal door keeps that room quiet.
applications: Rs 4,10,400 ex GST, Rs 4,84,272 with 18 per cent GST
2 external doors plus 1 internal door, 10 windows

panels.h3: 40 x 10 ft Site Office Container Seating Fifteen People
panels.paragraph: Ten feet of width lets both walls of the common office carry desks. Seven workstations sit along the rear wall and five along the front, which brings the total to twelve. Add the manager and two guest chairs and the cabin seats fifteen. The 10 ft manager room stays private behind the partition. Most infrastructure and EPC teams land here once the site crosses roughly forty people on the ground, and paperwork needs its own desks.
applications: Rs 5,13,000 ex GST, Rs 6,05,340 with 18 per cent GST

panels.h3: 40 x 12 ft Site Office Container With a Wide Clear Aisle
panels.paragraph: The widest approved layout carries the same twelve workstations as the 40 x 10 ft plan. What you buy with the extra two feet is the aisle. Seven feet of clear floor runs between the two desk runs, so a plan table opens without anyone standing up. The manager cabin also gains width. Choose this when the office doubles as the daily coordination room rather than only a desk space. Both desk runs still take the standard 4 x 2.5 ft module.
applications: Rs 6,09,120 ex GST, Rs 7,18,762 with 18 per cent GST
